topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the learning outcomes and connecting the upcoming material to previous histopathology practicals.

topics.label: Discovery and Experimental Assays of Transforming Genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and describe the laboratory assays used to test transforming capacity.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Oncogenes, Tumour Suppressor Genes, and Cell Cycle Control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major classes of cancer-associated genes and explain how mutations in oncogenes and tumour suppressor genes perturb cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Genetic Instability and Multi-Step Tumour Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular defects that generate sequence and chromosomal instability and show how this instability accelerates the stepwise accumulation of mutations during tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Tumour Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inherited germline mutations accelerate cancer onset and how hereditary tumors evolve under therapeutic selection.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing for the lecture, reviewing learning outcomes, recommending background reading, and previewing the next session.
